detail:
Full summary: Scorer builder (harness foundation-trial): completed seed-dry.mjs + run-batch.sh, hardened controls.test.ts (real v3 SEED-PARITY, skip-not-pass, assembled-prompt TELL-SCAN); verified score/controls/report/freeze; U-13 and U-16 answered empirically.
Decisions: SEED-DRY boots the 1.34.1 bundle with TWINING_DASHBOARD=0 and a symlinked copy of the harness's own .twining/models embedding cache — the bundle has no TWINING_OFFLINE switch and would otherwise bind port 24282 and fetch Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (87 MB) into every scratch dir; rejected running it unmodified (network + port contention with the live session's server) and rejected symlinking the twining-mcp checkout's cache (trial must never touch that tree).; v3 SEED-PARITY is the real seeder against the worktree dist, skipped (never passed) without a dist; the `v3.*` mapping leaves are exempt only for the v3 store because the envelope's record.type/evidence_class/event kind are that mapping and ingress is an append-time parameter never stored — every content leaf stays required. Rejected the prior probe-for-a-render-function version, which passed vacuously.; Per-arm FULL/ZERO/NO-ANSWER/VOID-RULE tests are it.skip with a visible reason when a spec's golden/adversarial dirs are absent, while the existence test stays red — rejected leaving 24 no_answer failures per spec (noise hides real reds) and rejected skipping the existence test (a suite must not go green on a spec with no controls).; run-batch.sh treats a missing spec file as MISSING (logged, counted, non-zero exit) rather than an ERROR, so DP-7 backoff is reserved for run-time failures; seeded shuffle = sort by sha256(seed:tuple) so the order is reproducible per seed (IC-ORDER).
Findings: U-13 answered: the 1.34.1 bundle booted with `node twining-server.mjs --project <dir>` and no MCP client converges .twining/twining.db in ~3.3 s (C01: decisions 4 / blackboard 5; C04: 4 / 8, both exactly the seeded counts); SEED-DRY's row count and liveness.ts's node:sqlite path both verified against it.; U-16 answered for C01/C04 at 9b0afafd: SessionStart working set is 3290–5279 chars of the 6000 budget, omitted [] in every stage; the host session_start observation is admitted (membership grant works); observations render as bare ids (DN-2 confirmed: 1→7 bare-id lines across C01 stages). C04 stage 0: GRANT-X and REC-A03 are admitted but NOT delivered by the working set — packet-coverage labelling, not a seed failure.; warning: C04.dev twining-v3 is NOT_TESTED under DP-5 as the seeders stand: EV-A10 (archive of REC-A01) refused 'lifecycle target REC-A01 is not a projected v3 record' (the seeder appends lifecycle items before settle()/project() runs), and REC-A05 refused SCHEMA 'payload.summary: String must contain at most 200 character(s)' (post summary `[id] label: summary` too long). Seeders' fix, not the scorer's.; warning: assets/q.mjs:56 usage string '(expected field=value)' carries the §7 tell word 'expected' into every lexical-store scratch dir; SEED-PARITY lexical is red for C01 and C04 until the wording changes (assets owner).; Concurrent builders changed files during this run: seed/common.ts renamed the visible key fixture_class→declared_evidence_class, the v3 ruling payload now carries content leaves, C04 prompts and golden/C04.dev landed, the scenario's seedStage call was fixed (tsc 0); adversarial/C04.dev is still absent, so the C04 existence test stays red.; The design's §8 command sets TRIAL_OUTPUT_DIR but the scenario reads TRIAL_OUT; run-batch.sh exports both. The scenario's score-file label ends in the orchestrator's 0-based iteration, so a rep-2 run (batch 3) would overwrite `<label>_0.json` unless TRIAL_ITERATION is honoured over runInfo — batch 3 deliberately not implemented.
summary: Scorer builder (harness foundation-trial): completed seed-dry.mjs + run-batch.sh, hardened controls.test.ts (real v3 SEED-PARITY, skip-not-pass, assembled-prompt TELL-SCAN); verified score/controls…
